name: Search
description: The search form in a site's navigation. It's an input group, so its field, button and colors come from the Input Group contract; this holds only what's specific to search, and the button that shows it on small screens.
sources: Arizona Bootstrap 5.2: .az-search, made stable by az-digital/arizona-bootstrap#2277

padding.x.$description: Space to the left and right of the search form.

padding.y.$description: Space above and below the search form.

toggle.description: The button that shows the search form on small screens.

ring.width.$description: Width of that button's keyboard focus ring.
